title: USDA Disaster Nutrition Assistance Programs
program_name: Disaster SNAP (D-SNAP) and USDA Disaster Nutrition Assistance
content: The Disaster Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (D-SNAP) is activated following major disasters and has provided benefits to eligible individuals who were not eligible for regular SNAP benefits but experienced disaster-related expenses. USDA also operates the Disaster Household Distribution Program and supports congregate feeding. USDA works through state and local partners to distribute aid. USDA advises: if you are in need of food for your family following a disaster, contact the disaster relief organization in your area to determine where you can find food assistance.
next_action: Contact your local disaster relief organization or Department of Social Services to find food assistance and to learn whether D-SNAP has been activated for your area.
